description: Curated, realistic one-page resume used ONLY to render the 20 template gallery preview images in public/templates/. Not used by the app at runtime. Content is deliberately moderate so every template's first page looks complete without overflowing.
summary: Product-minded engineer with 8+ years building fast, accessible web applications for fintech and healthcare. Led a cross-functional team that redesigned checkout for 2M+ customers and cut p95 page load from 4.1s to 1.2s. Comfortable owning a problem end to end, from discovery and design partnership through rollout and on-call.

experience.summary: Tech lead for checkout and merchant onboarding, serving 2M+ customers across three markets.
bullets: Redesigned the checkout flow with the design team, lifting conversion by 11% and cutting p95 load time from 4.1s to 1.2s.
Introduced typed end-to-end tests and progressive delivery, reducing production regressions by 70% across 40 releases.
Mentored four engineers and led the accessibility guild that brought the product to WCAG 2.1 AA.
Built a scheduling service in Node.js and PostgreSQL that handled 30k appointments per day with 99.95% availability.
Automated release pipelines with GitHub Actions, taking deployments from a weekly manual process to on-demand.
Partnered with clinical staff to ship a patient intake flow that cut form completion time by 35%.

projects.name: Ledger Lens
projects.description: An open-source dashboard that explains every cent of variance between payment processor reports and internal ledgers, with drill-downs and audit trails.
highlights: Processes 9M ledger entries per day with incremental materialised views.
Used by three small finance teams; 900+ GitHub stars.

education.details: Thesis: Adaptive Load Shedding for Multi-Tenant Payment APIs.

achievements: Winner, Northwind Engineering Excellence Award 2023 for the checkout redesign.
Speaker at React India 2022: “Accessible by Default”.
Maintainer of two open-source utilities with a combined 1,400 GitHub stars.
